question: The Consumer Protection Act, 2019 was passed in 2019 and came into force in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2020.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Consumer Protection Act, 2019__ came into force on **20 July 2020.**
 
• This new Act will empower consumers and help them in protecting their rights through its various notified Rules and provisions.
 
• The Act includes the establishment of the Central Consumer Protection Authority, CCPA to promote, protect and enforce the rights of consumers.
